{{Top|leg}}
'''Natamee''' was a raft-village on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. It was a frequent stop for fishing vessels on shore leave.<ref name="Ando">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030703ando|text=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men|int=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men}}</ref>
